bibl.title: Offerings and libations for the king and the question of ruler-cult in Egyptian temples.
bibl.seg: Stefan Pfeiffer, Offerings and libations for the king and the question of ruler-cult in Egyptian temples.
Stefano G. Caneva (ed.), with the collaboration of L. Lorenzon, The Materiality of Hellenistic Ruler Cults = Kernos. Supplément 36 (Liège, 2020) pp. 83-102.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Setting the context: two asylia petitions from Euhemeria and Greek agents in Egyptian temples. - The problem of the hyper-formula. - Egyptian rituals for the well-being of the pharaoh. - The meaning of temple dedications using the hyper-formula. - The relation of the hyper-formula to ruler cult in Egyptian temples. - Conclusions.
